reason: A DSH plugin that provides plugin-development guidance by injecting CAN, SHOULD, MUST NOT, and SHOULD NOT rules into the system prompt and exposing the guidance in a settings sidebar item.

summaries.zh: 该插件向 DSH 智能体系统提示词注入插件开发规范，并在设置侧边栏提供对应入口。
summaries.en: This plugin injects DSH plugin-development rules into the agent system prompt and adds a corresponding settings sidebar entry.

capabilities: Injects a development-rules section into the agent system prompt
Registers a plugin-development item in the settings sidebar
Injects a development-rules section into the agent system prompt
